tools.name: check_store_prices
tools.description: Read an online store's products, prices and availability, and what changed since its previous daily snapshot. Use it for questions like "track competitor prices on allbirds.com", "what did gymshark.com change?", "did this store drop prices?", "what is new or sold out at this store?". Pass store web

tools.name: get_product_price_history
tools.description: Read how one product's price and availability moved over the days a store has been tracked. Use it for questions like "how has the price of this hoodie changed?", "when did this product go on sale?", "has this been out of stock?". Pass the store's web address and the product's link, handle or title

tools.name: compare_store_prices
tools.description: Compare product prices between two online stores to find price gaps, spreads, and margin differences. Use it for questions like "compare prices between allbirds.com and allbirds.co.uk", "find the price gap for hoodies between two stores", or "which store sells this item cheaper?". Pass source_store

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_store_prices, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Public sink: check_store_prices, submit_feedback · Destructive: check_store_prices, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_store_prices, get_feedback_reply, index_tools · Public sink: check_store_prices, submit_feedback · Destructive: check_store_prices, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
